name: motion-speed-ramp
title: Speed Ramp into a Hit
description: Chuyển động chậm dần còn 25 % ngay trước cú va, đúng phách mạnh thì va, rồi tăng tốc trở lại.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Recipe: over a 1200 ms move into a hit, speed 100 % until 300 ms before the impact, eased down to 25 % over those 300 ms, the impact frame on the downbeat, then back to 100 %. Small demo: rate 100 % until 0.8 s, linear ramp to 25 % over 500 ms, 50 ms at 25 % (impact), then 130 % at once; a dot integrates the rate (130 px/s at 100 %) with a 6-copy trail. As an ease / time-remap: ramp(slow 0.25, window 0.3 s, impact time). Params: slow (25 %) · window: đoạn chậm (0.3 s) · impact: lúc va (giây) · after (100 %). The dot integrates the rate, so a ramp is a time remap: slow into the hit, land it on the downbeat, then fast out.
moworks.titleVi: Dồn tốc chậm lại trước cú va
